caption:
In about 1 of 10 cases, the lingual nerve ran above the lingual crest in the mandibular third molar region. In an MRI study of 10 volunteers (20 sides), the nerve lay above the lingual crest in 10% and was in direct contact with the lingual plate in 25%. On average it was 2.75 mm below the crest and 2.53 mm from the lingual plate. This is why incisions and flap retraction in the retromolar area stay on the buccal side. Note: small sample of 20 sides.

Source: Miloro M, Halkias LE, Slone HW, Chakeres DW. Assessment of the lingual nerve in the third molar region using magnetic resonance imaging. J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 1997;55(2):134-137. doi:10.1016/S0278-2391(97)90228-7
